stories.title: Trump Rejects Talk of A.I. Regulation and Calls Out Anthropic’s CEO
stories.sum: The president again rejected calls to try to regulate the industry, even as some of its leaders are speaking more openly about the risks of rapidly developing artificial intelligence.

stories.title: Beijing hits back at Anthropic CEO’s call to curb China's AI development
stories.sum: China’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs has hit back at a call from the head of Anthropic for the U.S. to curb China’s artificial intelligence capabilities

stories.title: Largest Roman mosaic opens to the public
stories.sum: The first-century mosaic and accompanying fresco located beneath the Baths of Trajan in Rome welcomed its first visitors this past weekend

stories.title: Art History and Pop Culture Converge in Frederich Kunath’s ‘The Nearest Faraway Place’
stories.sum: The artist describes that he aims to make his paintings “feel like songs.” Do stories and artists like this matter to you?

stories.title: Ana María Caballero - The Linguistic Implications of Generative AI
stories.sum: Ana María Caballero discusses Being Borges and Speech Patterns, revealing how AI exposes the limits of translation and turns performance, intention, and emotion into visual and sculptural form.

stories.title: FTSE 100 outperforms as AI worry hits Wall Street
stories.sum: US President Donald Trump attacked what he called a ‘sick conspiracy’ against AI, rejecting calls for regulation.

stories.title: Australian film First Light submitted for the 2027 Best International Feature Academy Award

stories.title: Willo Perron creates a triumphant set design for Céline Dion's return to the stage
stories.sum: On Saturday, Céline Dion's fans welcomed her back to the stage in Paris. We take a look behind the scenes of the set design, by Wallpaper* Designer of the Year Willo Perron

stories.title: S&P Global backs Kaiko as Series B reaches $110M

stories.title: Vincent Delieuvin Named Director of Louvre’s Painting Department
stories.sum: The Musée du Louvre in Paris has appointed French art historian and curator Vincent Delieuvin to lead its Department of Paintings.

stories.title: Sotheby’s to Offer $90 M. in Art from Richard Hedreen’s Collection, Ahead of Major University Gift
stories.sum: The roughly 50 works, led by a $20 million to $30 million Roy Lichtenstein, are being sold as Hedreen moves forward with his major art gift to Seattle University.

stories.title: Danish-Egyptian director May el-Toukhy wins Venice Golden Lion for Woman Unknown
stories.sum: Danish-Egyptian director May el-Toukhy has won the Golden Lion, the highest prize given to a film at the Venice Film Festival, for Woman Unknown.
